cohort: The study included 177 pregnant inpatients and delivered outpatients in Dubai, UAE, all presenting with haemoglobin levels less than 12g/dL.
finding: The prevalence of blood transfusion was low (7.3%) but increased with the severity of iron deficiency anemia.
mod_finding: Postpartum hemorrhage was significantly higher in vaginally delivered ladies (37.9%) compared to those delivered by cesarean section (4.5%).
birth_weight: Measured for neonates, with 76.8% having normal birthweight and 18.1% having low birthweight.
gest_age: Measured at diagnosis and delivery, with parity defined as live neonate or gestational age more than 24 weeks.
